Guidance & outlook: KIOCL recorded a Profit After Tax (PAT) of H16.57 crore and a Profit Before Tax (PBT) of H11.89 crore for FY 2025-26, as against a steep Loss After Tax of H204.58 crore in the preceding financial year.
Total turnover rose to H708.26 crore, compared to H640.63 crore in FY 2024-25, with Revenue from Operations reaching H613.46 crore.
Alongside Financially, the division continues to thrive, generating H3.49 crores in FY 2025- 26 and securing a eight-year cumulative revenue of H42.70 crores.
Growth & demand: We extended the Conversion and Marketing & Sale Agreements through November 28, 2026, while securing substantial volume enhancements: the Iron Ore Fines (IOF) conversion quantum was augmented from 3.30 million WMT to 5.72 million WMT, and the marketing quantum from 3.0 million DMT to 5.20 million DMT.

Consequently, KIOCL achieved a record dispatch of 27.71 lakh tonnes of NMDC- converted pellets across 53 shipments- the highest dispatch volume clocked by the Company since the closure of the Kudremukh captive mine in 2006.

Modernization, Backward Integration & Supply Chain Efficiencies To protect operating margins against high raw material and merchant coke costs, your Company made decisive progress on its capital growth plans: Coke Oven Plant (BFU Integration): Construction of our 1.80 LTPA captive Coke Oven Plant at Mangaluru, with an outlay of H218.30 crore, achieved 76% ph…
Margins & costs: The revised agreement expanded the annual conversion capacity from 1.0 MTPA to 3.0 MTPA, enabling higher plant utilisation while significantly reducing our exposure to fluctuations in iron ore and pellet prices.

Outcome Higher capacity utilisation Stable conversion revenue Lower inventory risk Improved operational continuity 50th Annual Report 2025-26KIOCL Ltd Backwards and Forward integration projects Cost Optimisation through Smarter Sourcing Key Achievements Our integration programme, approved at a total outlay of H836.90 crore, is designed to improve cost compet…
Cost Records and Cost Audit The Company is maintaining the cost records and requirement of cost audit as prescribed under the provisions of Section 148(1) of the Companies Act, 2013.
Capex & expansion: Approximately 7.5 million saplings have been planted in and around the former Kudremukh mining area, complemented by plantation drives undertaken across the Mangaluru plant and surrounding communities.
CAPEX During the year under review the total CAPEX was H 27.09 crores, which was 19.77% of the Budget Estimate (BE) of H 137 crores against previous years CAPEX of H 27.34 crores.
